annotations.title: Ask acts about a booking (no fee needed)

description: Send the connected member's enquiry to up to 6 GigXchange artists at once - the same "Ask these acts" request as the website. Each act gets the enquiry in their GigXchange Messages with a notification and an email, and replies there with their price and availability. No fee is offered and no booking is created. Only send what the member has asked for and confirmed in this conversation. Max 3 requests a day, counting any the member sent from the website. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch. Not connected? Each act's profile url has a Get in touch button that sends the same request from the website.

acts.description: The artists to ask, by profile SLUG from a search result (e.g. "the-nile-session"); profile ids are also accepted. 1-6.

budget.description: Optional budget in words, e.g. "around 500" (max 40 chars).

event_date.description: Optional event date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. Leave out for "any date".

message.description: Optional note to the acts (max 1000 chars): set times, the vibe, anything they should know.

place.description: Where the event is - a town or venue (max 120 chars).
